URL: https://www.lbc.co.uk/article/uk-inflation-rate-falls-5Hjddyx_2/
NOTE: (LBC/PA — RAC stat, approved via RAC) RAC said average diesel at UK forecourts dropped >16p/litre from start to end of June — largest fall since records began in 2000 (driven by US-Iran interim ceasefire, oil below pre-crisis levels). Chancellor John Healey: "Falling inflation is news families want to hear but there is much more to do to give people the breathing space they need... yesterday we cut VAT on electricity bills and today we're announcing a £2 cap on bus fares from January... Both these changes are a win-win. They help keep inflation down while helping people afford the essentials." Food inflation 1.7% (from 2.2%).
